row.scim_price_text: Enterprise: $200/mo ($2,400/yr) incl. 3 members; extra members $50/mo each
row.team_price_text: Engage: $17.5/mo ($210/yr) incl. 1 member; extra members $17.5/mo each, max 5
row.evidence: Slido's pricing page lists "SSO for members & participants" and "Member provisioning" under Enterprise only, and the SCIM help article says member provisioning is "Available in Enterprise and Institution plans".
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated), but prices changed since June: Enterprise is now self-serve at $200/mo billed $2,400 annually with 3 members included and extra members at $50/mo each (June: Contact Sales, ~$200/mo for 3 users); Engage is $17.5/mo billed $210 annually with 1 member and up to 5 members (June: ~$10/mo). Annual plans only (no monthly payments). Pricing is a base fee per licence plus per-member add-ons, so scim_price_per_user_mo and the multiplier are null; Engage's base and extra-member price are both $17.5/mo, so that is used as the team per-user price. June's claim that Slido is included free with paid Webex licences had no first-party source found and was dropped. Slido says it offers no open API.

auth.token_source: Organization Settings and billing > Member SAML SSO > Provisioning > Generate Token
auth.notes: Token shown once; can be deactivated.

operations.notes: Okta OIN page checks Create, Update, Deactivate. SCIM groups drive optional role provisioning where the IdP supports it.

roles.how: Optional SCIM-based role provisioning via SCIM groups (off by default); otherwise a default role (User, changeable) is assigned

limitations.text: With provisioning on, members can no longer be managed at slido.com, only from the IdP.
Guests must be provisioned into the organisation unless 'Exclude guests' is ticked.

user_api.notes: A Data API exists for export use cases (datapi-*.slido.com, OAuth2), not for member management.

okta.notes: OIN 'Slido Admin' checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate.

entra.notes: Slido lists Entra ID as a verified provisioning setup (guide is a PDF on cdn.pathfactory.com, not citable); no Microsoft gallery tutorial found (slido-tutorial 404).

onelogin.notes: Slido lists OneLogin as a verified provisioning setup; catalogue listing not checked.
